vectors.name: emitter-valid-instance
vectors.reason: A correctly attested collision-warning instance validates.

vectors.name: emitter-priority-injection-rejected
vectors.reason: The runtime envelope is closed; a payload-side priority override must be rejected, not ignored.

vectors.name: emitter-renderer-override-rejected
vectors.reason: Renderer selection belongs to the declaration and Translation, never to the emission.

vectors.name: emitter-unknown-algorithm-rejected
vectors.reason: Algorithm identifiers outside the fixed profile must be rejected (downgrade resistance).

vectors.name: emitter-missing-key-id-rejected
vectors.reason: An attestation without a key identity cannot be verified or revoked.

vectors.name: emitter-action-node-deferred
vectors.reason: Action is not emittable in the sia-minimal 0.4 profile.

vectors.name: renderer-cannot-issue-timeout
vectors.reason: Delivery timeout is a Coordination Runtime event; a renderer must not claim it.

vectors.name: renderer-success-carries-no-failure-reason
vectors.reason: A presented receipt with a failure reason is contradictory evidence.

vectors.name: renderer-capability-valid
vectors.reason: An attested safety-relevant capability declaration with evidence validates.

vectors.name: renderer-safety-claim-needs-evidence
vectors.reason: A renderer must not self-promote to safety_relevant without accepted evidence.

vectors.name: runtime-alert-must-never-block
vectors.reason: An applicable critical Alert cannot be silently droppable by context policy.

vectors.name: runtime-coalesce-requires-ttl-and-key
vectors.reason: Unbounded or keyless coalescing is non-conformant retention.

vectors.name: runtime-empty-trust-contract-rejected
vectors.reason: A declaration without trust requirements must not enter a catalog.

vectors.name: runtime-timeout-is-not-an-occupant-action
vectors.reason: A response timeout must carry runtime evidence, never verified-input evidence.

vectors.name: runtime-context-requires-all-core-axes
vectors.reason: A decision snapshot missing a core axis is not a valid basis for policy.

vectors.name: runtime-audit-chain-needs-predecessor
vectors.reason: A hash-linked audit record validates; chain-position invariants are covered by the invariant tests.
